coverage_note: Higher-education institutions (universities, schools, research centres) from the MESRS, built from two of the ministry's own publications: its university-network listing, and its BAC 2026 placement file ("Moyennes minimales BAC 2026, suite a la premiere phase"), which names every establishment it places new bacheliers into by the ministry's own establishment code. The placement file supplies 12 institutions the network listing omits, the current name of 2 it still lists under an older one, and one succession: ENSTA, which decret executif 22-398 made the successor of the two Algiers schools it dissolved, so those two ids are retired and forwarded to it in retired-ids.json. 83 records carry an open per-campus coordinate (exact); the other 104 are commune or wilaya centroids (approximate), because neither publication carries an address or a coordinate.
